descriptionSections.plainText: About the project, As a Senior Data Engineer, you will have the exciting opportunity to work with a team of technology experts on challenging projects across various industries, leveraging cutting-edge technologies. Here are some of the projects we are seeking talented individuals to join:, •	Development and maintenance of a large platform for processing automotive data. A significant amount of data is processed in both streaming and batch modes. The technology stack includes Spark, Cloudera, Airflow, Iceberg, Python, and AWS., •	Design and development of a universal data platform for global aerospace companies. This Azure and Databricks powered initiative combines diverse enterprise and public data sources. The data platform is at the early stages of the development, covering design of architecture and processes as well as giving freedom for technology selection., •	Centralized reporting platform for a growing US telecommunications company. This project involves implementing BigQuery and Looker as the central platform for data reporting. It focuses on centralizing data, integrating various CRMs, and building executive reporting solutions to support decision-making and business growth.
elements: As a Senior Data Engineer, you will have the exciting opportunity to work with a team of technology experts on challenging projects across various industries, leveraging cutting-edge technologies. Here are some of the projects we are seeking talented individuals to join:

•	Development and maintenance of a large platform for processing automotive data. A significant amount of data is processed in both streaming and batch modes. The technology stack includes Spark, Cloudera, Airflow, Iceberg, Python, and AWS.

•	Design and development of a universal data platform for global aerospace companies. This Azure and Databricks powered initiative combines diverse enterprise and public data sources. The data platform is at the early stages of the development, covering design of architecture and processes as well as giving freedom for technology selection.

•	Centralized reporting platform for a growing US telecommunications company. This project involves implementing BigQuery and Looker as the central platform for data reporting. It focuses on centralizing data, integrating various CRMs, and building executive reporting solutions to support decision-making and business growth.

descriptionSections.plainText: About the project, As a Data Engineer, you will have the exciting opportunity to work with a team of technology experts on challenging projects across various industries, leveraging cutting-edge technologies.  Here are some of the projects we are seeking talented individuals to join:, •	Design and development of a universal data platform for global aerospace companies. This Azure and Databricks powered initiative combines diverse enterprise and public data sources. The data platform is at the early stages of the development, covering design of architecture and processes, as well as giving freedom for technology selection., •	Data Platform Transformation for energy management association body.  This project addressed critical data management challenges, boosting user adoption, performance, and data integrity. The team is implementing a comprehensive data catalog, leveraging Databricks and Apache Spark/PySpark, for simplified data access and governance. Secure integration solutions and enhanced data quality monitoring, utilizing Delta Live Table tests, established trust in the platform. The intermediate result is a user-friendly, secure, and data-driven platform, serving as a basis for further development of ML components., •	Design of the data transformation and following data ops pipelines for global car manufacturer. This project aims to build a data processing system for both real-time streaming and batch data. We’ll handle data for business uses like process monitoring, analysis, and reporting, while also exploring LLMs for chatbots and data analysis. Key tasks include data cleaning, normalization, and optimizing the data model for performance and accuracy.

descriptionSections.plainText: About the project, Join our newly created European Data & Analytics HUB! - we are growing!, This strategic initiative is created to enable the change of Volkswagen Financial Services (VWFS) to a data-driven company. Our goal is to empower all VWFS business units to use data effectively, efficiently and compliantly in their business decisions., D&A originally has been set up as central HQ function located in Germany. elements: Join our newly created European Data & Analytics HUB! - we are growing!

This strategic initiative is created to enable the change of Volkswagen Financial Services (VWFS) to a data-driven company. Our goal is to empower all VWFS business units to use data effectively, efficiently and compliantly in their business decisions.

D&A originally has been set up as central HQ function located in Germany. To strengthen D&A’s international profile and to cope with the increasing demand for D&A’s services, the European D&A Hub has recently been established in Warsaw, Poland. The teams in both locations work closely aligned to deliver outstanding data products and services for international data use cases at VWFS group.
Data Foundation — About:​

The Data Foundation team makes the company’s data available, and thus builds the groundwork for the efficient use of data by all business units at VWFS. We want to make accessing data feel like shopping at a market: everything in one place, easy to find, and in reliable quality. We cover the entire process from initial data requirements to reliable integrated data provisioning for analytical, administrative, and operational purposes.

descriptionSections.plainText: About the project, As a Data Engineer, you will have the exciting opportunity to work with a team of technology experts on challenging projects across various industries, leveraging cutting-edge technologies. Here are some of the projects we are seeking talented individuals to join:, •	Development and maintenance of a large platform for processing automotive data. A significant amount of data is processed in both streaming and batch modes. The technology stack includes Spark, Cloudera, Airflow, Iceberg, Python, and AWS., •	Design and development of a universal data platform for global aerospace companies. This Azure and Databricks powered initiative combines diverse enterprise and public data sources. The data platform is at the early stages of the development, covering design of architecture and processes as well as giving freedom for technology selection., •	Centralized reporting platform for a growing US telecommunications company. This project involves implementing BigQuery and Looker as the central platform for data reporting. It focuses on centralizing data, integrating various CRMs, and building executive reporting solutions to support decision-making and business growth.

•	Design and development of a universal data platform for global aerospace companies. This Azure and Databricks powered initiative combines diverse enterprise and public data sources. The data platform is at the early stages of the development, covering design of architecture and processes as well as giving freedom for technology selection.

•	Centralized reporting platform for a growing US telecommunications company. This project involves implementing BigQuery and Looker as the central platform for data reporting. It focuses on centralizing data, integrating various CRMs, and building executive reporting solutions to support decision-making and business growth.

descriptionSections.plainText: About the project, Google Cloud’s mission is to make every business successful through AI by combining cutting-edge technology, infrastructure, and talent. AI/ML software engineers in Cloud bridge the gap between pioneering models and a massive product vehicle reaching billions. Our talent density and AI-powered tools drive rapid development, rooted in a culture of empowerment and a bias to action. elements: Allegro Pay is Central Europe's largest and fastest growing fintech - the only place where financial solutions can be created on such a large scale, using state-of-the-art technology. We work on purchase financing and payment methods that are used daily by customers of Allegro, the most popular shopping platform in Poland and one of the largest e-commerce companies in Europe. Due to this scale, we have the opportunity to work on one of the most exciting purchase financing and payment solutions in our country. We are looking for talented people who want to create powerful and stable solutions to support a product with over a dozen million active users.
The role

We're looking for a Software Engineer with a solid foundation in .NET and backend development to join a cross-functional team focused mainly on greenfield projects - building new products and features from the ground up. You'll help deliver seamless, end-to-end customer journeys - from opening a bank account and activating a fast payment method directly within the Allegro app, through funding the account, to authorizing payments and rewarding customers with cashback, all in just a few taps. Alongside building new features, you'll focus on improving system performance, scalability and reliability, and on raising the quality and maintainability of our codebase. You'll work closely with product, design and business stakeholders, taking ideas from concept to production quickly and iterating based on real user feedback.
Our team builds and scales two products:

Allegro Klik - lets Allegro users link an existing bank account or open a new one directly within the Allegro app for instant payments with cashback. We own the full flow: account linking and opening, payment processing, top-ups, cashback calculation and cashback-driven promotional campaigns.

Allegro Care - insurance offered directly in the Allegro shopping experience, letting customers protect their purchases (e.g. against damage, theft, or with extended warranty) right at checkout, with policy management handled seamlessly within the platform.
Both products are growing fast, with new initiatives launched continuously alongside scaling of our existing systems.
Important things for you
Flexible working hours in the hybrid model (4/1) - working hours start between 7:00 a.m. and 10:00 a.m. We also have 30 days of occasional remote work.
The salary range for this position depending on the skill set is as follows (contract of employment, tax-deductible cost):
-  PLN gross 11 200 - 15 250
- Annual bonus based on your annual performance and company results.
Our team is based in Warsaw and Poznań.

Jesteśmy polską firmą z blisko 20-letnim doświadczeniem na rynku. Nasza historia zaczęła się w 2007 roku, a dziś, dzięki dynamicznej transformacji, wspieramy nie tylko sektor IT, ale również branże takie jak inżynieryjna, budowlana, telekomunikacyjna oraz wiele innych.
W ITC wierzymy, że technologia nas łączy, ale to relacje nas budują.
Nie jesteśmy zwykłym dostawcą usług – przejmujemy operacyjne wyzwania rekrutacyjne, aby nasi klienci mogli w pełni skupić się na swojej strategii i rozwoju.
Co nas wyróżnia?
•Wszechstronność: Dostarczamy nie tylko programistów i testerów, ale także inżynierów, kierowników projektów oraz analityków biznesowych.
•Elastyczne modele współpracy: Specjalizujemy się w outsourcingu personalnym (body leasing), rekrutacjach stałych, headhuntingu oraz modelu Try&Hire.

•Podejście Human-Centric: Dla nas ludzie to nie cyferki. Stawiamy na autentyczność, wellbeing i zdrowie psychiczne naszych specjalistów, co przekłada się na ich efektywność i stabilność zespołów u naszych klientów.
•Innowacyjność i stabilność: Jesteśmy laureatem Polskiej Nagrody Innowacyjności oraz wielokrotnym zdobywcą tytułu Gazele Biznesu.
Szukasz specjalistów do swojego zespołu lub nowej ścieżki zawodowej?
Skontaktuj się z nami i sprawdźmy, co możemy wspólnie zbudować!

descriptionSections.plainText: About the project, Allegro Pay is Central Europe's largest and fastest growing fintech - the only place where financial solutions can be created on such a large scale, using state-of-the-art technology. We work on purchase financing and payment methods that are used daily by customers of Allegro, the most popular shopping platform in Poland and one of the largest e-commerce companies in Europe. Due to this scale, we have the opportunity to work on one of the most exciting purchase financing and payment solutions in our country. We are looking for talented people who want to create powerful and stable solutions to support a product with over a dozen million active users., , , The role, , , We're looking for a Software Engineer with solid, proven experience in .NET and backend development to join a cross-functional team focused mainly on greenfield projects — building new products and features from the ground up. You'll take ownership of designing and delivering seamless, end-to-end customer journeys — from opening a bank account and activating a fast payment method directly within the Allegro app, through funding the account, to authorizing payments and rewarding customers with cashback, all in just a few taps. Alongside building new features, you'll drive improvements in system performance, scalability, and reliability, and help raise the quality and maintainability of our codebase. You'll work closely with product, design, and business stakeholders, translating ideas into robust technical solutions, and collaborate with and support less experienced teammates as the team grows., , Our team builds and scales two products:, , Allegro Klik - lets Allegro users link an existing bank account or open a new one directly within the Allegro app for instant payments with cashback. We own the full flow: account linking and opening, payment processing, top-ups, cashback calculation and cashback-driven promotional campaigns., , Allegro Care - insurance offered directly in the Allegro shopping experience, letting customers protect their purchases (e.g. against damage, theft, or with extended warranty) right at checkout, with policy management handled seamlessly within the platform., , Both products are growing fast, with new initiatives launched continuously alongside scaling of our existing systems., , Important things for you:, , Flexible working hours in the hybrid model (4/1) - working hours start between 7:00 a.m. and 10:00 a.m. We also have 30 days of occasional remote work., , The salary range for this position depending on the skill set is as follows (contract of employment, tax-deductible cost):, , - PLN gross 14 600 - 20 825, - Annual bonus based on your annual performance and company results., , Our team is based in Warsaw and Poznań.
elements: Allegro Pay is Central Europe's largest and fastest growing fintech - the only place where financial solutions can be created on such a large scale, using state-of-the-art technology. We work on purchase financing and payment methods that are used daily by customers of Allegro, the most popular shopping platform in Poland and one of the largest e-commerce companies in Europe. Due to this scale, we have the opportunity to work on one of the most exciting purchase financing and payment solutions in our country. We are looking for talented people who want to create powerful and stable solutions to support a product with over a dozen million active users.
The role

We're looking for a Software Engineer with solid, proven experience in .NET and backend development to join a cross-functional team focused mainly on greenfield projects — building new products and features from the ground up. You'll take ownership of designing and delivering seamless, end-to-end customer journeys — from opening a bank account and activating a fast payment method directly within the Allegro app, through funding the account, to authorizing payments and rewarding customers with cashback, all in just a few taps. Alongside building new features, you'll drive improvements in system performance, scalability, and reliability, and help raise the quality and maintainability of our codebase. You'll work closely with product, design, and business stakeholders, translating ideas into robust technical solutions, and collaborate with and support less experienced teammates as the team grows.
Our team builds and scales two products:

Allegro Klik - lets Allegro users link an existing bank account or open a new one directly within the Allegro app for instant payments with cashback. We own the full flow: account linking and opening, payment processing, top-ups, cashback calculation and cashback-driven promotional campaigns.

Allegro Care - insurance offered directly in the Allegro shopping experience, letting customers protect their purchases (e.g. against damage, theft, or with extended warranty) right at checkout, with policy management handled seamlessly within the platform.
Both products are growing fast, with new initiatives launched continuously alongside scaling of our existing systems.
Important things for you:
Flexible working hours in the hybrid model (4/1) - working hours start between 7:00 a.m. and 10:00 a.m. We also have 30 days of occasional remote work.
The salary range for this position depending on the skill set is as follows (contract of employment, tax-deductible cost):
- PLN gross 14 600 - 20 825
- Annual bonus based on your annual performance and company results.
Our team is based in Warsaw and Poznań.

descriptionSections.plainText: Doświadczenie w trudnych projektach: Udokumentowana, samodzielna realizacja projektów prognostycznych na zaszumionych szeregach czasowych o niskim stosunku sygnału do szumu (krypto, finanse, biosygnały, CTR, predictive maintenance) w ujęciu end-to-end — wraz z umiejętnością omówienia kryteriów przerwania nieudanych eksperymentów., Zaawansowana walidacja szeregów czasowych: Biegłe projektowanie schematów walidacji z uwzględnieniem specyfiki danych czasowych (walk-forward, purging, embargo, dobór okien, zmiany reżimu) oraz pełna świadomość, dlaczego klasyczny, losowy k-fold jest błędem metodycznym., Rozumienie specyfiki niskiego SNR: Świadomość, że przy wysokim szumie trafność na poziomie 52% może być wartościowym wynikiem, podczas gdy wynik 65%+ wskazuje niemal zawsze na błąd walidacyjny lub przeciek danych (data leakage)., Podejście baseline-first oraz sprawność działania: Umiejętność dostarczenia prostego modelu bazowego w kilka dni (a nie tygodni) oraz gotowość do rezygnacji ze złożonych sieci neuronowych, jeśli nie generują przewagi nad baseline'em., Solidne podstawy statystyczne i analityczne: Praktyczna znajomość pojęć istotności i mocy testów, problemu wielokrotnego testowania, przedziałów ufności oraz stacjonarności. Umiejętność interpretacji zachowań sieci (krzywe uczenia) i natychmiastowego wyłapywania przetrenowania., Inżynieria oprogramowania i stack technologiczny: Produkcyjna znajomość Pythona, higiena pracy w systemie Git, tworzenie powtarzalnych środowisk (uv, venv, Docker) oraz codzienna praca z DuckDB i formatem Parquet., Pragmatyczne wykorzystanie LLM: Używanie narzędzi AI do budowania pipeline'ów i boilerplate'u przy jednoczesnej bezwzględnej, ręcznej weryfikacji logiki podziału danych oraz konstrukcji targetu., Zwinna samodzielność i kompetencje językowe: Umiejętność samodzielnego planowania pracy bez potrzeby szczegółowo rozpisywanych ticketów, przy jednoczesnym wyczuciu momentu na konsultację techniczną z zespołem. Biegła znajomość języka polskiego (komunikacja wewnętrzna) oraz angielskiego w stopniu umożliwiającym swobodne dyskusje z klientem.
elements: Doświadczenie w trudnych projektach: Udokumentowana, samodzielna realizacja projektów prognostycznych na zaszumionych szeregach czasowych o niskim stosunku sygnału do szumu (krypto, finanse, biosygnały, CTR, predictive maintenance) w ujęciu end-to-end — wraz z umiejętnością omówienia kryteriów przerwania nieudanych eksperymentów.

Zaawansowana walidacja szeregów czasowych: Biegłe projektowanie schematów walidacji z uwzględnieniem specyfiki danych czasowych (walk-forward, purging, embargo, dobór okien, zmiany reżimu) oraz pełna świadomość, dlaczego klasyczny, losowy k-fold jest błędem metodycznym.

Rozumienie specyfiki niskiego SNR: Świadomość, że przy wysokim szumie trafność na poziomie 52% może być wartościowym wynikiem, podczas gdy wynik 65%+ wskazuje niemal zawsze na błąd walidacyjny lub przeciek danych (data leakage).

Podejście baseline-first oraz sprawność działania: Umiejętność dostarczenia prostego modelu bazowego w kilka dni (a nie tygodni) oraz gotowość do rezygnacji ze złożonych sieci neuronowych, jeśli nie generują przewagi nad baseline'em.

Solidne podstawy statystyczne i analityczne: Praktyczna znajomość pojęć istotności i mocy testów, problemu wielokrotnego testowania, przedziałów ufności oraz stacjonarności. Umiejętność interpretacji zachowań sieci (krzywe uczenia) i natychmiastowego wyłapywania przetrenowania.

Inżynieria oprogramowania i stack technologiczny: Produkcyjna znajomość Pythona, higiena pracy w systemie Git, tworzenie powtarzalnych środowisk (uv, venv, Docker) oraz codzienna praca z DuckDB i formatem Parquet.
Pragmatyczne wykorzystanie LLM: Używanie narzędzi AI do budowania pipeline'ów i boilerplate'u przy jednoczesnej bezwzględnej, ręcznej weryfikacji logiki podziału danych oraz konstrukcji targetu.

elements: Key Responsibilities
Production Support Ownership and Codebase Stability
Own senior support for the in-house US Retail Funds codebase, covering incidents, recurring issues, defects, outages and user impact.
Lead hands-on technical support across business, support, development, QA, vendors, infrastructure and technology teams.
Investigate complex production issues in logic, data, batches, interfaces, environments, access, infrastructure and procedures.
Drive root-cause analysis, timely fixes, service recovery, controlled workarounds and permanent remediation.
Improve resilience by reducing key-person dependency and documenting support ownership and issue history.
Lead QA, Test Governance and Release Readiness
Lead QA planning and execution for enhancements, fixes, releases, regression, production defects and urgent changes.
Define test strategy, scope, acceptance criteria, regression coverage, data, environments and evidence needs.
Assess changes for impact, quality risks, downstream dependencies, support needs and release readiness.
Govern defect triage, priority, tracking and closure; ensure clear evidence, reproducibility, ownership and timely fixes.
Validate fixes, test evidence and production readiness with developers, business and support teams.
Improve QA discipline, regression efficiency, automation coverage, repeatability and release confidence.
US-Facing Production Support and Operational Continuity
Support US-based business teams, clients and operations reliably.
Work late, unsocial or shifted hours as needed for US coverage, releases, incidents and deadlines.
Own prompt investigation and resolution of incidents, recurring defects, data issues, user problems and outages.
Maintain usable support processes, escalation routes, knowledge documentation and runbooks.
Reduce single-person dependency with clear support ownership and transparent issue history.
Enhancement Support, Defect Remediation and Release Control
Support enhancements, fixes and releases from analysis through build validation, testing, deployment and monitoring.
Align with stakeholders on priorities, operational impact, support pain points and outcomes.
Contribute to walkthroughs, testing, defect triage, release notes, migrations, deployment and rollback plans.
Require impact assessments, test evidence, user validation, decision records and readiness checks.
Escalate support and quality risks, constraints, delays, recurring defects and critical issues with recommendations.
Codebase Knowledge Transfer and Operating Model
Formalise existing knowledge into delivery discipline, documentation, support ownership and technical governance.
Document architecture, application behaviour, data dependencies, Azure, MoveIT, connectors, adaptors, recurring issues, support and releases.
Replace informal knowledge with repeatable documentation, handovers and operating procedures.
Identify technical debt, fragile processes, workarounds and risks to scale, stability and future delivery.
Help transition from incumbent-led knowledge to a resilient, transparent delivery model.
Stakeholder Collaboration and Technical Governance
Report development progress, risks, blockers, incidents, release readiness and business impact clearly.
Work with US stakeholders on priorities, requirements and operationally effective changes.
Track actions, decisions, defects, dependencies and open issues across development and support.
Escalate early with practical recommendations, not only status updates.
Represent the codebase credibly in technical, business and support discussions.
Uphold ethics, transparency, accountability and traceability in decisions, issues, escalation and communication.
Coordinate early with infrastructure on dependencies, risks, changes, access, environments and operational impact.
Document decisions, assumptions, risks, analysis, support steps and handovers thoroughly.

This isn’t just another dev role. It’s your chance to engineer the core of global trading.

We’re talking ultra-low-latency architectures, real-time market data, and automation at scale — all in an environment where milliseconds matter and billions move. You’ll work on greenfield and semi-greenfield projects, building trading systems for equities, options, FX (forex), and more.

The Role at a Glance
• Senior Java Backend Engineer
• Building trading systems, including high-performance backend services for algorithmic order management and order routing (multiple projects & various asset classes)
• Fully remote for a top N. American bank (for residents of Poland or Romania)
• Part of the core team - this is not a legacy support role or an outsourced B team
This role requires experience building trading systems, ideally with order routing or algorithmic order management. Some capital markets experience is required.
If you enjoy working on low-latency, high-throughput trading systems, join us and build the next generation of high-performance capital markets solutions.

Welcome to Group Technology, where we pride ourselves on engineering solutions and direct Nordea's transformation by providing a holistic technological view and structured understanding of the bank, and its surrounding environment to enable the Customer Vision and the Business Strategy.

Meet Default Management team in SD High Risk and SD C & I. Our role is to support the lending business by providing data solutions for ongoing loan servicing and monitoring.

*  Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines to automate software deployment and release processes
*  Automate monitoring and reconciliation
*  Release deployment, verification and follow-up and Incident investigations and management
*  Application provider, governance and compliance
*  Operate and monitor system performance and troubleshoot issues to ensure high availability and reliability

*  Work closely with development teams to integrate DataOps/ BizDevOps best practices into the software development lifecycle and to enhance collaboration, automation, and efficiency across the organization
*  Work closely with development teams to help support our Nordea BizDevOps ambitions with architects and hardware/infrastructure engineers within Nordea

descriptionSections.plainText: About the project, As a Senior Data Engineer, you will have the exciting opportunity to work with a team of technology experts on challenging projects across various industries, leveraging cutting-edge technologies.  Here are some of the projects we are seeking talented individuals to join:, •	Design and development of a universal data platform for global aerospace companies. This Azure and Databricks powered initiative combines diverse enterprise and public data sources. The data platform is at the early stages of the development, covering design of architecture and processes, as well as giving freedom for technology selection., •	Data Platform Transformation for energy management association body.  This project addressed critical data management challenges, boosting user adoption, performance, and data integrity. The team is implementing a comprehensive data catalog, leveraging Databricks and Apache Spark/PySpark, for simplified data access and governance. Secure integration solutions and enhanced data quality monitoring, utilizing Delta Live Table tests, established trust in the platform. The intermediate result is a user-friendly, secure, and data-driven platform, serving as a basis for further development of ML components., •	Design of the data transformation and following data ops pipelines for global car manufacturer. This project aims to build a data processing system for both real-time streaming and batch data. We’ll handle data for business uses like process monitoring, analysis, and reporting, while also exploring LLMs for chatbots and data analysis. Key tasks include data cleaning, normalization, and optimizing the data model for performance and accuracy.

elements: Agent Development: Build, iterate, and maintain AI agents within the architecture and boundaries defined by the Lead AI Engineer. Own your agents end-to-end: prompt design, tool wiring, context routing, failure handling, and output validation.

Data Integration: Integrate data components across media platforms — ingesting, normalizing to schema, and routing to the correct agent context. Work within defined data contracts and surface schema drift before it becomes a runtime failure.

Evaluation-First Development: No feature enters development without defined success criteria and regression tests. Run prompt benchmarking, track output quality across model versions, and flag hallucination patterns or quality regressions proactively. Evaluation is not a post-build step.

Pipeline & ETL Work: Build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines supporting daily automated callouts and weekly optimisation reporting. Own data freshness and pipeline reliability for the agents you are responsible for.

MCP Connector Work: Operate within and extend the MCP connector library for external platform APIs. Handle rate limits, retries, and failure modes — connectors must be resilient in production, not just in testing.

Human-in-the-Loop Workflows: Build and maintain Slack-based approval flows — agent callouts, feedback capture, exception alerts, and operational notifications. These are the primary interface between the AI system and human decision-makers.

Production Reliability: Own the reliability of your agents in production. Monitor output quality, respond to incidents, drive root-cause fixes rather than surface patches. Alert the Lead AI Engineer early on scope or complexity that affects delivery.

Our projects range from greenfield builds to re-architecting existing platforms, from small two-week engagements to multi-year deliveries, across several industries. elements: Ready to reshape a data platform from the ground up? Join Us!

You won't be locked into one project. Our projects range from greenfield builds to re-architecting existing platforms, from small two-week engagements to multi-year deliveries, across several industries. Some weeks you design a data lake from scratch, other weeks you migrate an orchestration layer or tune a warehouse. What stays constant is ownership: we work in a "we build it, we run it" model, so every engineer deploys their own solutions to production without handing off to anyone else.
The stack you'll work with
We pick tools per project, but this is the technology you'll typically touch:
•	Data Warehouse / Data Lakehouse architectures on AWS alongside streaming and batch pipelines,
•	Apache Iceberg as the open table format,
•	Data Warehouses and query engines: DuckDB, Amazon Redshift, Amazon Athena, Amazon S3 Tables, Snowflake, ClickHouse, and other AWS-native data services,
•	Airflow (AWS MWAA) and AWS Step Functions for orchestration,
•	Apache Kafka and Amazon Kinesis for streaming, Debezium for CDC,
•	dltHub for ingestion, dbt with Cosmos (ELT) or Apache Spark (ETL) for data transformations,
•	Amazon ECS for running application workloads,
•	OpenMetadata for metadata and data lineage,
•	Terraform for infrastructure as code.

As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.

As a Platform Customer Engineer (CE), you will partner with technical Sales teams to differentiate Google Cloud to our customers. You will serve as the customer’s primary technical partner and trusted advisor, engaging in technical-led conversations to understand their business issues. You will troubleshoot technical questions and roadblocks, engage in proofs of concepts and demos, and use your expertise to architect cross-pillar cloud solutions that solve these business issues. You will use your strategic acumen and presentation skills to engage with technical and business leaders, and persuasively present practical and useful solutions on Google Cloud. You will have a breadth of technical expertise, spanning infrastructure modernization, application modernization, data analytics and more and blend sales expertise, market knowledge and direct technical engagement to prove the value of the Google Cloud portfolio.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

elements: Własny R&D: Prowadzenie eksperymentów prognostycznych end-to-end — od postawienia hipotezy, przez automatyzację agentową AI, po raportowanie i obronę wniosków.

Wdrożenie standardu badań: Wyznaczenie i egzekwowanie metodyki eksperymentalnej dla całego zespołu (jasna hipoteza, poprawny split, baseline, kryterium stopu). Dostajesz w tym obszarze pełną samodzielność.
Sparing merytoryczny: Review prac zespołu — weryfikacja poprawności walidacji, wyłapywanie przecieków danych (data leakage), ocena stabilności modeli w oknach czasowych.
Świadomy dobór narzędzi: Decydowanie, kiedy użyć gradient boostingu, sieci neuronowych, czy modeli fundamentalnych (Chronos, TimesFM), a kiedy odpuścić dany kierunek.
Kontakt z klientem: Prowadzenie merytorycznych dyskusji technicznych i prezentowanie wyników po angielsku.

descriptionSections.plainText: Doświadczenie w trudnych projektach: Udokumentowana, samodzielna realizacja projektów prognostycznych na zaszumionych szeregach czasowych o niskim stosunku sygnału do szumu (krypto, finanse, biosygnały, CTR, predictive maintenance) w ujęciu end-to-end — wraz z umiejętnością omówienia kryteriów przerwania nieudanych eksperymentów., Zaawansowana walidacja szeregów czasowych: Biegłe projektowanie schematów walidacji z uwzględnieniem specyfiki danych czasowych (walk-forward, purging, embargo, dobór okien, zmiany reżimu) oraz pełna świadomość, dlaczego klasyczny, losowy k-fold jest błędem metodycznym., Rozumienie specyfiki niskiego SNR: Świadomość, że przy wysokim szumie trafność na poziomie 52% może być wartościowym wynikiem, podczas gdy wynik 65%+ wskazuje niemal zawsze na błąd walidacyjny lub przeciek danych (data leakage)., Podejście baseline-first oraz sprawność działania: Umiejętność dostarczenia prostego modelu bazowego w kilka dni (a nie tygodni) oraz gotowość do rezygnacji ze złożonych sieci neuronowych, jeśli nie generują przewagi nad baseline'em., Solidne podstawy statystyczne i analityczne: Praktyczna znajomość pojęć istotności i mocy testów, problemu wielokrotnego testowania, przedziałów ufności oraz stacjonarności. Umiejętność interpretacji zachowań sieci (krzywe uczenia) i natychmiastowego wyłapywania przetrenowania., Inżynieria oprogramowania i stack technologiczny: Produkcyjna znajomość Pythona, higiena pracy w systemie Git, tworzenie powtarzalnych środowisk (uv, venv, Docker) oraz codzienna praca z DuckDB i formatem Parquet., Pragmatyczne wykorzystanie LLM: Używanie narzędzi AI do budowania pipeline'ów i boilerplate'u przy jednoczesnej bezwzględnej, ręcznej weryfikacji logiki podziału danych oraz konstrukcji targetu., Zwinna samodzielność i kompetencje językowe: Umiejętność samodzielnego planowania pracy bez potrzeby szczegółowo rozpisywanych ticketów, przy jednoczesnym wyczuciu momentu na konsultację techniczną z zespołem. Biegła znajomość języka polskiego (komunikacja wewnętrzna) oraz angielskiego w stopniu umożliwiającym swobodne dyskusje z klientem.
elements: Doświadczenie w trudnych projektach: Udokumentowana, samodzielna realizacja projektów prognostycznych na zaszumionych szeregach czasowych o niskim stosunku sygnału do szumu (krypto, finanse, biosygnały, CTR, predictive maintenance) w ujęciu end-to-end — wraz z umiejętnością omówienia kryteriów przerwania nieudanych eksperymentów.

Zaawansowana walidacja szeregów czasowych: Biegłe projektowanie schematów walidacji z uwzględnieniem specyfiki danych czasowych (walk-forward, purging, embargo, dobór okien, zmiany reżimu) oraz pełna świadomość, dlaczego klasyczny, losowy k-fold jest błędem metodycznym.

Rozumienie specyfiki niskiego SNR: Świadomość, że przy wysokim szumie trafność na poziomie 52% może być wartościowym wynikiem, podczas gdy wynik 65%+ wskazuje niemal zawsze na błąd walidacyjny lub przeciek danych (data leakage).

Podejście baseline-first oraz sprawność działania: Umiejętność dostarczenia prostego modelu bazowego w kilka dni (a nie tygodni) oraz gotowość do rezygnacji ze złożonych sieci neuronowych, jeśli nie generują przewagi nad baseline'em.

Solidne podstawy statystyczne i analityczne: Praktyczna znajomość pojęć istotności i mocy testów, problemu wielokrotnego testowania, przedziałów ufności oraz stacjonarności. Umiejętność interpretacji zachowań sieci (krzywe uczenia) i natychmiastowego wyłapywania przetrenowania.

Inżynieria oprogramowania i stack technologiczny: Produkcyjna znajomość Pythona, higiena pracy w systemie Git, tworzenie powtarzalnych środowisk (uv, venv, Docker) oraz codzienna praca z DuckDB i formatem Parquet.
Pragmatyczne wykorzystanie LLM: Używanie narzędzi AI do budowania pipeline'ów i boilerplate'u przy jednoczesnej bezwzględnej, ręcznej weryfikacji logiki podziału danych oraz konstrukcji targetu.

Zwinna samodzielność i kompetencje językowe: Umiejętność samodzielnego planowania pracy bez potrzeby szczegółowo rozpisywanych ticketów, przy jednoczesnym wyczuciu momentu na konsultację techniczną z zespołem. Biegła znajomość języka polskiego (komunikacja wewnętrzna) oraz angielskiego w stopniu umożliwiającym swobodne dyskusje z klientem.

elements: Purpose of the Role
We are seeking a technically strong Software Engineer with experience in application development, system integrations, and agile delivery to support the Fund Services business.

This role is responsible for designing, developing, and supporting technology solutions while working closely with business stakeholders, Product Owners, operational teams, and clients to deliver enhancements that improve business processes and client outcomes.

The successful candidate will combine strong software engineering capability with business and systems understanding, translating business requirements into scalable technical solutions across applications, integrations, automation, and data processes.

Due to the business-facing nature of this role, the position requires close collaboration with US-based stakeholders and clients during their operating hours. The role acts as a key technology partner, providing timely support, requirements clarification, solution input, and issue resolution.
Role Scope
The Software Engineer will support the full software delivery lifecycle, including requirements analysis, solution design, development, testing, deployment, and production support.

The role works closely with business users to understand operational challenges, identify opportunities for automation and improvement, and deliver technology solutions aligned with business objectives.

descriptionSections.plainText: About the project, Ready to reshape a data platform from the ground up? Join Us!, , You won't be locked into one project. Our projects range from greenfield builds to re-architecting existing platforms, from small two-week engagements to multi-year deliveries, across several industries. elements: Ready to reshape a data platform from the ground up? Join Us!

You won't be locked into one project. Our projects range from greenfield builds to re-architecting existing platforms, from small two-week engagements to multi-year deliveries, across several industries. Some weeks you design a data lake from scratch, other weeks you migrate an orchestration layer or tune a warehouse. What stays constant is ownership: we work in a "we build it, we run it" model, so every engineer deploys their own solutions to production without handing off to anyone else.
The stack you'll work with
We pick tools per project, but this is the technology you'll typically touch:
•	Data Warehouse / Data Lakehouse architectures on AWS alongside streaming and batch pipelines,
•	Apache Iceberg as the open table format,
•	Data Warehouses and query engines: DuckDB, Amazon Redshift, Amazon Athena, Amazon S3 Tables, Snowflake, ClickHouse, and other AWS-native data services,
•	Airflow (AWS MWAA) and AWS Step Functions for orchestration,
•	Apache Kafka and Amazon Kinesis for streaming, Debezium for CDC,
•	dltHub for ingestion, dbt with Cosmos (ELT) or Apache Spark (ETL) for data transformations,
•	Amazon ECS for running application workloads,
•	OpenMetadata for metadata and data lineage,
•	Terraform for infrastructure as code.

Jesteśmy polską firmą z blisko 20-letnim doświadczeniem na rynku. Nasza historia zaczęła się w 2007 roku, a dziś, dzięki dynamicznej transformacji, wspieramy nie tylko sektor IT, ale również branże takie jak inżynieryjna, budowlana, telekomunikacyjna oraz wiele innych.
W ITC wierzymy, że technologia nas łączy, ale to relacje nas budują.
Nie jesteśmy zwykłym dostawcą usług – przejmujemy operacyjne wyzwania rekrutacyjne, aby nasi klienci mogli w pełni skupić się na swojej strategii i rozwoju.
Co nas wyróżnia?
•Wszechstronność: Dostarczamy nie tylko programistów i testerów, ale także inżynierów, kierowników projektów oraz analityków biznesowych.
•Elastyczne modele współpracy: Specjalizujemy się w outsourcingu personalnym (body leasing), rekrutacjach stałych, headhuntingu oraz modelu Try&Hire.

•Podejście Human-Centric: Dla nas ludzie to nie cyferki. Stawiamy na autentyczność, wellbeing i zdrowie psychiczne naszych specjalistów, co przekłada się na ich efektywność i stabilność zespołów u naszych klientów.
•Innowacyjność i stabilność: Jesteśmy laureatem Polskiej Nagrody Innowacyjności oraz wielokrotnym zdobywcą tytułu Gazele Biznesu.
Szukasz specjalistów do swojego zespołu lub nowej ścieżki zawodowej?
Skontaktuj się z nami i sprawdźmy, co możemy wspólnie zbudować!
